## Code

[**VBC**](https://henrifnk.github.io/VBC/): vine copula based bias correction for climate models (R package, version 1.0.0). Corrects the multivariate distribution of heavy-tailed, zero-inflated and continuous climate variables. Accompanies the JRSS-C paper above.

[**FACT**](https://github.com/henrifnk/FACT): Feature Attributions for Clustering. Transfers algorithm-agnostic interpretability methods to clustering tasks. Accompanies the xAI 2023 paper above. (Formerly on CRAN; source now maintained on GitHub.)

[**FuzzyDBScan**](https://github.com/henrifnk/FuzzyDBScan): fuzzy clustering with DBScan. (Formerly on CRAN; source now maintained on GitHub.)
